titles.en: A New Skin: This Site Goes Multilingual
titles.zh: 新皮肤：本站走向多语言
titles.es: Una Nueva Piel: Este Sitio Se Vuelve Multilingüe
titles.pt: Uma Nova Pele: Este Site Torna-se Multilíngue

summaries.en: After two and a half months, mingjian.cc is back online — verified, redesigned, and now speaking English, Chinese, Spanish, and Portuguese.
summaries.zh: 搁置两个半月后，mingjian.cc 重新上线——已验证、已重新设计，现在说四种语言：英语、中文、西班牙语、葡萄牙语。
